items.title: Iron Man
items.blurb: Tony Stark builds a suit of armor to escape captivity, then keeps building them. The film that started the shared universe experiment.

items.title: The Incredible Hulk
items.blurb: Bruce Banner runs from General Ross while searching for a cure. Loosely tied to the wider universe via a Stark cameo.

items.title: Iron Man 2
items.blurb: Stark faces palladium poisoning and a vengeful rival while S.H.I.E.L.D. quietly recruits him for something bigger.

items.title: Thor
items.blurb: Banished to Earth, Thor learns humility while Loki seizes the throne of Asgard.

items.title: Captain America: The First Avenger
items.blurb: Steve Rogers becomes a super-soldier and fights Hydra in WWII, ending frozen in ice for seventy years.

items.title: The Avengers
items.blurb: Loki invades New York with a Chitauri army; Earth's Mightiest Heroes assemble for the first time.

items.title: Iron Man 3
items.blurb: Stark grapples with PTSD after New York while facing the Mandarin — and the Extremis program.

items.title: Thor: The Dark World
items.blurb: The Aether resurfaces, and Thor must team with Loki to stop the Dark Elf Malekith.

items.title: Captain America: The Winter Soldier
items.blurb: Hydra's decades-long infiltration of S.H.I.E.L.D. is exposed; Bucky Barnes resurfaces as a brainwashed assassin.

items.title: Guardians of the Galaxy
items.blurb: A ragtag crew of misfits clashes over an Infinity Stone on the far side of the galaxy.

items.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
items.blurb: Stark's AI peacekeeping program goes catastrophically wrong, birthing Ultron and, eventually, Vision.

items.title: Ant-Man
items.blurb: Scott Lang inherits the Pym Particle suit and pulls off a heist that shrinks him to subatomic scale.

items.title: Captain America: Civil War
items.blurb: The Sokovia Accords split the Avengers into two camps, fracturing the team for years.

items.title: Doctor Strange
items.blurb: Surgeon Stephen Strange masters the mystic arts and confronts a threat from the Dark Dimension.

items.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
items.blurb: Star-Lord meets his celestial father Ego, forcing the Guardians to redefine what family means.

items.title: Spider-Man: Homecoming
items.blurb: Peter Parker balances high school with Avengers ambitions while the Vulture arms-deals alien tech.

items.title: Thor: Ragnarok
items.blurb: Asgard's destruction is prophesied as Hela, goddess of death, returns to claim the throne.

items.title: Black Panther
items.blurb: T'Challa assumes Wakanda's throne and must decide the isolationist nation's place in the world.

items.title: Avengers: Infinity War
items.blurb: Thanos hunts all six Infinity Stones. Half of all life in the universe turns to dust.

items.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp
items.blurb: Scott Lang and Hope van Dyne race to rescue Janet from the Quantum Realm — right before the Blip.

items.title: Captain Marvel
items.blurb: Set in 1995: Carol Danvers uncovers her past amid the Kree-Skrull war and pages a certain someone.

items.title: Avengers: Endgame
items.blurb: The survivors execute a time heist to undo the Snap, closing out the Infinity Saga.

items.title: Spider-Man: Far From Home
items.blurb: Peter navigates a post-Blip world and a manipulative hero named Mysterio while on a school trip.

items.title: WandaVision
items.blurb: Wanda Maximoff grieves Vision inside a sitcom-shaped reality bubble of her own making.

items.title: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
items.blurb: Sam Wilson and Bucky Barnes confront the Flag Smashers and the legacy of the Captain America mantle.

items.title: Loki (Season 1)
items.blurb: A variant Loki is arrested by the Time Variance Authority, unraveling the truth of the Sacred Timeline.

items.title: Black Widow
items.blurb: Set shortly after Civil War: Natasha Romanoff confronts her Red Room past and a surrogate family of spies.

items.title: What If…? (Season 1)
items.blurb: The Watcher observes key MCU moments splintering into alternate realities across the multiverse.

items.title: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
items.blurb: Shang-Chi confronts his father Xu Wenwu, wielder of the reality-warping Ten Rings.

items.title: Eternals
items.blurb: Immortal beings sent by the Celestials to protect Earth resurface after millennia in hiding.

items.title: Hawkeye
items.blurb: Clint Barton trains protégé Kate Bishop while a Ronin-related conspiracy resurfaces at Christmas.

items.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
items.blurb: A spell gone wrong pulls villains — and heroes — across the multiverse into Peter's world.

items.title: Moon Knight
items.blurb: Marc Spector discovers he shares a body — and an Egyptian god — with another personality entirely.

items.title: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness
items.blurb: Strange and America Chavez multiverse-hop while a corrupted Wanda hunts them as the Scarlet Witch.

items.title: Ms. Marvel
items.blurb: Kamala Khan discovers a bangle that grants her cosmic-tinged powers — and a bloodline secret.

items.title: Thor: Love and Thunder
items.blurb: Gorr the God Butcher hunts deities across the cosmos as Jane Foster wields Mjolnir once more.

items.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
items.blurb: Jennifer Walters juggles superhero law and Hulk-sized side effects of an emergency blood transfusion.

items.title: Werewolf by Night
items.blurb: A black-and-white monster-hunter special introducing Elsa Bloodstone and Man-Thing to the MCU.

items.title: Black Panther: Wakanda Forever
items.blurb: Wakanda mourns T'Challa while Namor's underwater nation of Talokan declares war.

items.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Holiday Special
items.blurb: The Guardians attempt to give Peter Quill the perfect Earth Christmas.

items.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp: Quantumania
items.blurb: The Langs and Pyms are pulled into the Quantum Realm and face its ruler: Kang the Conqueror.

items.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
items.blurb: The Guardians go to war with the High Evolutionary to save Rocket's life — and end their trilogy.

items.title: Secret Invasion
items.blurb: Nick Fury uncovers a decades-long Skrull infiltration of Earth's institutions.

items.title: Loki (Season 2)
items.blurb: Loki fights to save the TVA and the Sacred Timeline itself as it fractures at the loom.

items.title: The Marvels
items.blurb: Carol Danvers, Kamala Khan, and Monica Rambeau have their powers entangled and must team up.

items.title: Echo
items.blurb: Maya Lopez returns home to Oklahoma and confronts Kingpin's reach — and her own heritage.

items.title: Deadpool & Wolverine
items.blurb: Deadpool recruits a variant Wolverine to save his universe from erasure by the TVA.

items.title: Agatha All Along
items.blurb: Agatha Harkness assembles a coven to walk the deadly Witches' Road and reclaim her power.

items.title: What If…? (Season 2)
items.blurb: More divergent timelines, including a Wakandan Doctor Strange and Peggy Carter's super-soldier serum.

items.title: Captain America: Brave New World
items.blurb: Sam Wilson's new Captain America confronts a geopolitical crisis tied to adamantium and a Hulk-like Red Hulk.

items.title: Daredevil: Born Again (Season 1)
items.blurb: Matt Murdock returns to the mask as Wilson Fisk becomes Mayor of New York.

items.title: Thunderbolts*
items.blurb: A team of morally grey operatives is forced together and stumbles into a fight bigger than any of them.

items.title: Ironheart
items.blurb: Riri Williams builds her own armor and gets pulled toward the sorcerer known as the Hood.

items.title: Eyes of Wakanda
items.blurb: An animated anthology tracing Wakandan warriors across centuries, from 1260 BCE onward.

items.title: The Fantastic Four: First Steps
items.blurb: Set on a retro-futuristic alternate Earth: the First Family faces Galactus and the Silver Surfer.

items.title: Wonder Man
items.blurb: Stuntman Simon Williams gets a shot at superhero stardom — with strings attached.

items.title: Marvel Zombies
items.blurb: An animated horror spin-off exploring a zombie-outbreak variant of the What If…? multiverse.

items.title: What If…? (Season 3)
items.blurb: The Watcher's anthology continues, spinning further divergent threads ahead of the Multiverse Saga's climax.

items.title: Daredevil: Born Again (Season 2)
items.blurb: Matt Murdock's war with Fisk escalates as New York's underworld reshuffles.

items.title: The Punisher: One Last Kill
items.blurb: Frank Castle is pulled back into New York's crime war alongside Daredevil's orbit.

items.title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day
items.blurb: Peter Parker navigates a rebuilt life and reputation ahead of Earth's next great convergence.

items.title: Avengers: Doomsday
items.blurb: Heroes from across the Multiverse Saga converge to face Victor von Doom.

items.title: Avengers: Secret Wars
items.blurb: The culmination of the Multiverse Saga — incursion-level stakes across realities.
